Role profile
The job a user holds in the app (Admin, Accountant, Procurement Executive, ...). It decides which screens and buttons they get.
Admin
A user with the role profile Nirmaan Admin Profile: sees every project and may approve, pay, delete and manage users.
Software Developer
The new role profile Nirmaan Software Developer Profile (ADR-0051). It sees and does exactly what Admin does, everywhere, with its own orange badge.
DEVELOPER_PROFILE
The Software Developer profile's constant, in services/role_profiles.py and frontend/src/constants/roles.ts. Every check that names Admin (ADMIN_PROFILE) names it beside Admin.
Badge
The coloured label with a user's role in the Users list and on their profile. Admin's is its own colour; the developer's is orange.
Access gate
The check that locks a user on Dashboard when their role needs a project and they have none. Admin and the developer are not subject to it.
Reminder schedule
A compliance reminder (TDS filing, GST, PF ...) aimed at one or more role profiles. Its Pending reminders show in the dashboard's Action Center.
One-way reminders
A developer sees reminders aimed at the Admin profile as well as its own; an Admin does not see reminders aimed only at developers.
Review queue
Expenses › Pending Approval: the Expense Requests the viewer may approve or reject. A type with no reviewer of its own routes to Admin, so to developers too.
Rename Email
Users › a user › Actions › Rename Email: changes a user's login email. Admin-profile accounts cannot be renamed; developer accounts neither.
Snag bulk edit
Set status on several ticked snags at once. Admin only on develop; the developer too on this branch.
Departments
Assets › Departments: the list of departments people belong to. Admin and HR add, rename and switch them off.
TDS Approval
The screen where Admin approves the Technical Data Sheet requests raised on projects (not tax TDS). A viewer who may not approve sees a read-only banner on its Pending tab.
PO Invoices 2B Recon
Vendor Invoice Recon's list of approved Purchase Order invoices, with their GSTR-2B reconciliation. Admin's Actions column there edits or deletes an invoice.
Technology
The department this branch's patch adds (add_technology_department), for the Software Developers.
Made-up users
dev.walker@example.com (Software Developer) and rename.target@example.com (Accountant) exist only on the walk's after env, seeded for this walk.
Developer-only reminder
"Walk check: developer-only reminder": a made-up schedule seeded on the after env that targets only the Software Developer profile.
